document_contents.quote: The Respondent, inter alia, alleged that by dividing the work contract into two parts and paying service tax applicable under only one work contract, service tax amounting to Rs. 21,01,50,386/- has been evaded by the Petitioner.

Besides this, in this SCN, it was also alleged that the Petitioner is ineligible for seeking exemption from payment of service tax qua the job work provided by the Railway to the joint venture (which included the Petitioner as well).
